skill.title: Find where a line meets any circle
needs: Solve linear + order-2 with any coefficients

steps.title: Find the centre of circle t

lines.text: For $x^2 + y^2 + 2gx + 2fy + c = 0$ the centre is $(-g, -f)$.

steps.title: Find the point where y = k touches the circle

lines.text: The tangent $y = k$ is horizontal, so the radius to the point of contact is vertical.
The point of contact is directly below or above the centre, so it is $(-14, k)$.

steps.title: Substitute (-14, k) into the equation of t

lines.text: Two numbers that multiply to $-196$ and add to $-45$ are $-49$ and $4$.

steps.title: Find the angle between OD and OA

lines.text: $OA$ and $OB$ are tangents from $O$, so $OD$ bisects $\angle BOA$. $C$ lies on line $OD$.
The radius to the point of contact on $OA$ is perpendicular to $OA$, giving a right-angled triangle with hypotenuse $|OD|$.
